definitions.gloss: first grade; first class (the top level of a graded test or license)
definitions.explanation: The top level, or one of the top levels, in a graded system of tests and licenses. Often written 1{級|きゅう}.
Of the highest quality or skill.

examples.japanese: {英検|えいけん}{一級|いっきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed Grade 1 of the Eiken English test.

examples.japanese: {一級|いっきゅう}⟦{建築士|けんちくし}→建築士：24974_kenchikushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I qualified as a first-class registered architect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検定|けんてい}→検定：13131_kentei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ほど⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、{一級|いっきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最上位|さいじょうい}→最上位：24315_saijoui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese proficiency tests, the smaller the number the higher the level, and Grade 1 is often the top.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一級品|いっきゅうひん}→一級品：16294_ikkyuuhin⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一級|いっきゅう}だ。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}ども⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧{一級|いっきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦エンターテインメント→エンターテインメント：10775_entaateinmento⟧だ。
examples.english: This film is first-rate entertainment that both children and adults can enjoy.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
In Japanese tests and licenses ({英検|えいけん}, {漢検|かんけん}, ⟦{簿記|ぼき}→簿記：13786_boki⟧) the numbering runs downward: 3⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ is lower than 2{級|きゅう}, and 1{級|きゅう} is the top, sometimes with {準|じゅん}1{級|きゅう} (pre-1st grade) just below it. This is the reverse of school years.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一級|いっきゅう}⟦{建築士|けんちくし}→建築士：24974_kenchikushi⟧: first-class registered architect
- ⟦{一級品|いっきゅうひん}→一級品：16294_ikkyuuhin⟧: top-quality goods
- {一級|いっきゅう}{河川|かせん}: class-A river (a nationally managed river)
- {一級|いっきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧: first-rate skill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧: first-rate; the usual word for top people, companies and hotels
